name: Essential Loyalty
summary: Shopify loyalty and rewards app metered on loyalty-influenced orders rather than total orders, with VIP tiers and referrals on the free plan.
best_for: Shopify stores with genuine repeat business that want a loyalty programme priced on the orders it influences rather than on total volume, and stores selling in person too, since POS support arrives at $10 and the free tier carries VIP tiers and referrals
skip_if: your customers buy once and rarely return, because a loyalty programme has nothing to work with and the free tier shows you that within a month; or you need API work from the start, since integrations are 'on request' and only on the $79 tier
honest_knock:
Two things to read closely before you pay. The meter is honest (loyalty-influenced orders, not all orders) and that is in your favour, but it also means you cannot work out your tier from your order count. A store doing 3,000 orders a month with little repeat business may sit on Free; one doing 800 with a loyal base may not. Measure your repeat and referral orders for a month before you choose.

The second is an oddity on the listing itself. The free plan advertises an 'Advanced loyalty point program' while Starter at $10 advertises a 'Free loyalty point program', which read literally means the paid tier offers less on that line. It is almost certainly a labelling slip rather than a real downgrade, but it is the kind of line worth confirming with support before you upgrade for it.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month for up to 500 loyalty-influenced orders
pricing.notes: (re-read 2026-09-18 on apps.shopify.com/essential-loyalty-rewards-program) Four tiers, every amount unchanged since 22 August 2026, and the meter is still the whole decision: it counts loyalty-influenced orders — repeat sales and referrals — rather than every order your store takes, which the plan text states outright. Free covers up to 250 of those and is unusually complete: the point program, VIP tiers, a referral program, twelve-plus ways to earn points, product, cart, popup and account placements, built-in email notifications with Klaviyo, and discount, gift, shipping and credit rewards. Starter is $10 a month for up to 500, adding a dedicated loyalty landing page, full customisation, Shopify Flow, POS support for in-store loyalty and 24/7 human support. Essential is $24 for up to 1,500, adding loyalty status on the customer orders and profile pages and points in product cards. Growth is $79 for unlimited loyalty orders, with API integrations on request, white-glove onboarding and priority support. Paid plans carry a 14-day free trial. Charges are in USD and recur every 30 days. Developer Essential Apps. The listing works with Checkout, Customer accounts, Shopify POS, Shopify Flow, Shopify Admin, Judge.me, Klaviyo, Omnisend, Point of Sale and Shopify's native store credit, and names twenty interface languages while a feature bullet on the same page claims 180+ — the vendor's own FAQ (essential-apps.com/loyalty, read 19 Sep 2026) reconciles those two: the twenty are the languages the app's own interface ships in, and the 180+ covers translating the storefront-facing text into any language you sell in. Nothing on the listing says what happens when a plan's order cap is passed; the same vendor FAQ does: you are upgraded in place to the next tier, there is no per-order overage fee, and $79 a month is the ceiling — unlimited loyalty orders, everything included. So the worst case for a store that outgrows Free is the $79 tier, not a surprise bill. The review record has moved: 482 reviews at 5.0, up from 438 in August, distributed 473 five-star, 8 four-star, none at three or two, and 1 one-star.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Essential Loyalty on a Shopify development store: the install, the reward rate and program activation, the widget in the unsaved theme preview, the plan screens, a Starter test charge (approved, billed 0 dollars, still active) and the Cancel subscription dialog, in which Keep my plan was chosen. Nothing was paid, cancelled, uninstalled or saved in the theme. Install: the App Store listing (English) is called Essent Loyalty Program Rewards and says Free plan available. Free trial available., with a rating of 5.0 from 499 reviews and a launch date of 25 November 2024; in the admin the app is called Essential Loyalty by Essential Apps. Install was clicked at about 11:08 and the dialog Install app (customer data, staff and contributor data, view and edit store data) was approved. The app opened straight on Set reward rate. Core action: Set reward rate offers 3% Safe, 5% (Recommended - Common in stores like yours.) and 8% Aggressive; we kept 5% and pressed Setup program. The program page then showed 5% rate, Activate program and Enable placements, a Review pre-configured program marked Ready and the rule Points per spend: All products, base rate, 8 points per $ 1. We pressed Activate program, which later became Pause program. Placements: Enable app embed opened the theme editor, where the app embed Essential Loyalty was already on, with the text Click Save in top-right corner to enable Essential Loyalty App Embed. We did NOT save: the theme was left with Leave page and the unsaved change was discarded, so the theme was not changed. Afterwards the app home showed App embed off and Loyalty paused, so nothing is live for customers. Result in the preview (unsaved): a Rewards button at the bottom, the panel Welcome to Rewards program with Become a member and Join now, Ways to earn: Place an order - 4 points for every $1.00 spent, and Ways to redeem: Dynamic discount - $1.00 per 100 points. The admin says 8 points per $ 1 while the widget says 4 points for every $1.00 spent; we did not find out why, and no order was placed to see which one applies. Timing, approximate tester observations: the widget stood in the theme preview about 2 minutes after the install was approved, in 6 clicks (approve the install, Setup program, Activate program, Enable app embed, the Rewards button, Ways to earn). Plans: the Billing page (Simple pricing without surprises. Used by 5,846 stores) shows a banner Pro $149 struck through and $99 a month (Everything in Growth, plus unlimited loyalty orders and hands-on support. Limited offer until Dec 31), Starter $10 a month (500 loyalty orders), Essential $24 a month (1,500), Growth $79 a month (5,000) and a Free plan with 250 free loyalty orders; each paid plan has Start 14-day free trial, and there is a 30 Day Money Back Guarantee - No questions asked! Starter has Point of Sale, Landing page, SMS, Google review and visit streak points, Unlisted rewards and Shopify Flow triggers and actions. Essential adds Bonus points campaigns, Product card points, Orders and Profile placements, Store credits, Points and VIP expiry, Branded icons and email domain and Exclude Shipping and Taxes. Growth adds Analytics, Unlimited VIP Tiers, Earning rules and rewards per tier, Receipt and form submissions, Custom Collection and Product points, Auto-translate and a Thank you page and Checkout (Plus). Free has a Basic program, Referrals, 2 VIP tiers, 4 placements and Integrations. Differences with the dossier and the listing: Growth at $79 is limited to 5,000 loyalty orders and is not unlimited (unlimited is in the new Pro plan); Essential is $24 up to 1,500 orders; the listing says a single VIP tier on Free while the app says 2 VIP tiers; the free limit of 250 and the Starter limit of 500 match. Checkout: Starter opened the Shopify Approve subscription screen with You will not be billed for this test charge., the plan Starter, This app bills you for usage charges, a maximum of $199,99 USD per 30 days and You have a 14-day free trial ending on 1 Dec. The screen shows no price for Starter. An Add payment method row was visible but Approve could be pressed without a card, and we approved this test charge on the cheapest plan. The app then said Thank you for upgrading to Starter and showed Starter as Active, so a Starter test subscription is active now (no cost, trial until 1 Dec). Limits and cancelling: the FAQ says that above the free order limit a running program is paused and customers lose their points, rewards and VIP statuses, and that on a paid plan we auto upgrade you to a higher plan. The active plan has a button Cancel subscription in Billing. It opens Why are you cancelling? with seven reasons (It's too expensive, Something isn't working, A feature I need is missing, I'm not seeing results, I'm switching to another app, My store is closing or taking a break, Other), Keep my plan and a greyed out Continue. We chose Keep my plan, so nothing was cancelled and the plan is still Starter. The FAQ says you can downgrade to the free plan at any time, effective immediately, that paid features such as the Loyalty landing page are then disabled, that charging starts on the first day of the 30-day cycle after the trial, and that a refund can be requested within the first 30 days. Uninstall is in the app menu and was not clicked. Not tested: the shopper side (signing up, points on a test order, redeeming at checkout), POS, referrals, tiers, emails, analytics, Klaviyo and why the admin says 8 points while the widget says 4. Clean up: the app stays installed, the theme was not saved, the program is activated but the embed and placements are off (Loyalty paused) and the Starter test subscription is active. Our own tabs were closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The admin and the widget disagree on the points per dollar, the widget only goes live after the app embed is saved in the theme, and the app says Loyalty paused until then.
